convert_xlnet_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert a TensorFlow XLNet checkpoint to a PyTorch model with optional GLUE task fine-tuning
build_xlnet_sequence_classification: build an XLNetForSequenceClassification model from a TensorFlow checkpoint for GLUE tasks
build_xlnet_question_answering: build an XLNetForQuestionAnswering model from a TensorFlow checkpoint for SQUAD tasks
build_xlnet_language_model: build an XLNetLMHeadModel from a TensorFlow checkpoint for language modeling
load_tf_weights_in_xlnet: load TensorFlow weights into a PyTorch XLNet model from a checkpoint file
